description: AI news digest Sep 5: GPT-6 Astra launch, September model wave and prices, Spotify 90 pct token cut, DeepSeek chips, AI funding.
lead: September opened with a burst of flagship model releases, and the last 24 hours added pricing clarity, safety caveats, and practical builder lessons. This digest collects seven stories worth your time: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra launch, the Muse Spark 1.3 / Gemini 3.8 Flash / Claude Fable 5.1 wave, what the new models cost, a prompt-injection warning, Spotify's 90% token cut, DeepSeek's reported chip-cluster plans, and two big infrastructure raises. Every summary is in our own words; follow the links for the original reporting.
title: AI news digest — September 5, 2026: GPT-6 Astra, token cuts, and chip clusters
